actions.note: Learn artboard IDs, dimensions, font families, page structure.
Cache full Paper token set. Every var(--token) in extracted styles must resolve.
Confirm font weights and styles available for every font family in the file.

project_audit.instruction: Before extracting anything, resolve the project's conventions with ../reference/project-conventions.md (CLAUDE.md ## Conventions, else detect, else ask once and record). Then read the resolved files to learn the mapping target.
read: {token_files} - learn every {prefix}* custom property and its value
The project's main stylesheet(s) and {component_dir} - learn existing class naming patterns
The project's font setup (root font-family, font loader) - confirm which families of {font} are loaded
The project's prohibited and required patterns (CLAUDE.md, lint config, design-guard tests) - they override this skill

build_token_map_skeleton.instruction: Create an in-memory mapping from Paper token names to project token names. Paper files may use the project's {prefix} or generic names (--color-*, --spacing-*, --radius-*). Record the mapping before extraction begins.

project_audit.report: List each resolved value with its source (CLAUDE.md path, detected file, or user answer) before continuing.
